text:
Implementation, catalogue, optional extras, source timing/context metadata, paired validity diagnostics, high-level extraction, documentation and engineering verification are complete. Local changes are uncommitted and unpublished. Source fingerprints, checkpoint identities, runtime versions, synthetic input hashes, commands and raw-log hashes are preserved in artifacts/music-validation/qualification.json.
Checks: final focused music run 60 passed plus separately rerun pinned native MERT 1 passed (the first combined run skipped MERT because its revision env was missing); real Beat small0 checked at 2s and 31s. Broad unit suite 428 passed/3 skipped with NF_PARITY_NO_R_COMPARE=1; these skips require unavailable fmrimod. Smoke 7 passed/1 skipped. Ruff, Tier A validation, static release gate (49 public contracts), uv lock check and 74-page Quarto render passed. Broad unit suite predates final small backend error-boundary edits, which final focused tests cover.
Unmodified live R comparison fails on existing sibling-R manifest drift; artifacts/music-validation/unit.log retains 427 passes and that failure. Do not treat the isolated static pass as live R qualification. Lock refresh also resolves previously declared speech extras missing from baseline lock. No R contract was changed.
Pending decision: approved local music paths or a named public dataset, plus independent reference annotations for beat accuracy. Workspace requires synthetic or explicitly approved fixtures; only synthetic audio was used. Freeze genre-stratified evaluation clips and criteria before inspection; retain per-clip failures. No cross-genre accuracy, activation calibration, phrase-label or neural-interpretation claim is established. Next action is this empirical qualification once inputs are approved. All feature engineering tasks have been closed separately. Paths released at handoff.
